title: A Horizon-Independent Regret Bound for Optimistic Hedge in General-Sum Games
abstract: arXiv:2609.22839v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can simple learning rules keep their regret bounded in self-play? Recent work achieves constant regret bounds through modified regularization and higher-order prediction. Yet for Optimistic Hedge, arguably the most canonical method in games, the best known individual regret bound remains logarithmic. In this work, we prove that plain Optimistic Hedge with a constant step size can attain $O_{n,d}(1)$ individual regret in general-sum games with $n$ players and $d=(d_1,\ldots,d_n)$ actions, under expected loss-vector feedback. As a corollary, its time-averaged play enjoys an $O_{n,d}(1/T)$ coarse correlated equilibrium (CCE) gap. Our analysis represents Optimistic Hedge as a real-analytic recurrence on a compact space, which yields an exact finite-order difference relation that eliminates horizon dependence. Our proof hinges on nonconstructive Noetherianity argument of Frisch (1967), so the $(n,d)$-dependence remains implicit.

translated_title: 一般和博弈中乐观Hedge算法的视界无关遗憾界
translated_abstract: 简单的学习规则能否在自博弈中保持遗憾有界？近期的工作通过修改正则化项和高阶预测实现了常数遗憾界。然而对于Optimistic Hedge——可以说是博弈论中最经典的方法——已知最好的个体遗憾界仍然是对数级的。在本工作中，我们证明了在期望损失向量反馈下，采用常数步长的朴素Optimistic Hedge算法在具有 $n$ 个玩家、每个玩家有 $d=(d_1,\ldots,d_n)$ 个动作的一般和博弈中可以达到 $O_{n,d}(1)$ 的个体遗憾。作为推论，其时间平均策略享有 $O_{n,d}(1/T)$ 的粗糙相关均衡（CCE）差距。我们的分析将Optimistic Hedge表示为紧空间上的实解析递推关系，由此得到一个精确的有限阶差分关系，从而消除了对时间视界的依赖。我们的证明依赖于Frisch（1967）的非构造性诺特性（Noetherianity）论证，因此关于 $(n,d)$ 的依赖关系仍然是隐式的。
tldr: 本文证明了在一般和博弈中，采用常数步长的朴素Optimistic Hedge算法即可达到与时间视界无关的常数级个体遗憾界，且其时间平均策略以 $O(1/T)$ 的速度收敛到粗糙相关均衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that plain Optimistic Hedge with a constant step size achieves a horizon-independent constant individual regret in general-sum games, implying that its time-averaged play converges to coarse correlated equilibrium at rate $O(1/T)$.
